methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote:
This paper presents the requirements for en-
ergy management from the perspective of 
the International Organisation for Standard-
isation, European Union and the interna-
tional and current European legal situation.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Paper discusses EnMS implementation via ISO 50001 and the PDCA cycle, EU energy-efficiency directives, and energy-monitoring hardware (compact circuit-breaker, soft starter), but does not present, propose, evaluate, or critique any EnPI/EnB measurement model with identifiable variables, functional form, or construction/estimation approach. EnPI/EnB content is at most incidental (a tool/framework paper without measurement-model content).

paper_type.evidence_quote:
This paper ex-
amines whether the implementation of measures through standards, directives and regulations 
is sufficient to achieve the timely energy policy goals.

stage1.notes: Conceptual/policy paper on energy-management implementation (ISO 50001, PDCA cycle, EU directives, monitoring hardware). No EnPI/EnB measurement model characterised -> methodologically ineligible; Level A/B not charted.
